meta.title: 10bit422和8bit420究竟是个啥？差别大吗？
meta.title_en: 10-Bit 4:2:2 vs. 8-Bit 4:2:0 — What Are They, and Does It Matter?
meta.topic: 摄影科普 · 色深与色度采样

scenes.context: 想象你是画家：128色马克笔能画出丝滑渐变的城市晚霞，换成12色就只能画出带明显分界线的晚霞。这种颜色与颜色之间的明显分界线，就叫做色彩断层。语域：科普教学，比喻引入。
sentences: 想象你是一名画家，给你一套128色的马克笔套装。
Imagine you're a painter, and you're handed a 128-color marker set.
a marker set（马克笔套装）
你大概率只能画出这样的城市晚霞。
You'll most likely only be able to paint a sunset like this.
most likely（大概率）；paint a sunset（画晚霞）
这种颜色与颜色之间的明显分界线，就叫做色彩断层。
That obvious boundary between colors is called color banding.
color banding（色彩断层）；boundary（分界线）
paraphrase: 明显分界线 → an obvious boundary / a visible line
obvious boundary · visible line
色彩断层 → color banding / banding artifacts
color banding · banding artifacts
scenes.speak: Imagine you're a painter, and you're handed a 128-color marker set. You'll most likely only be able to paint a sunset like this. That obvious boundary between colors is called color banding.

scenes.context: 色彩断层源于颜色细分不够。决定颜色细分数量的就是色深，通常用多少比特形容。8比特每个通道256个灰度，约1670万色；10比特每通道1024个灰度，约10.7亿色，二者相差64倍。语域：科普教学，概念定义+数字对比。
sentences: 决定颜色细分数量的，就称之为色深。
What determines the number of color gradations is called color depth.
color depth（色深）；gradations（细分等级）
8比特大概是1670万色。
8-bit gives you about 16.7 million colors.
16.7 million colors（1670万色）
10比特总共大约为10.7亿色，二者相差64倍。
10-bit adds up to about 1.07 billion colors — a 64x difference.
1.07 billion（10.7亿）；a 64x difference（64倍差距）
paraphrase: 颜色细分 → color gradations / shades of color
color gradations · shades
64倍差距 → a 64x difference / 64 times more
64x difference · 64 times more
scenes.speak: What determines the number of color gradations is called color depth. 8-bit gives you about 16.7 million colors. 10-bit adds up to about 1.07 billion colors — a 64x difference.

scenes.title_cn: 阶梯比喻：为什么后期会断层
scenes.title_en: The Staircase Metaphor: Why Grading Breaks Down
scenes.context: 可以把色深理解成色彩的阶梯：阶梯越多色彩过渡越自然。相机支持10bit就能拍出过渡更自然的画面，尤其是面对渐变画面时后期调整更明显。这也解释了为什么之前建议用log模式拍视频时不要用8bit——在有限色彩空间塞进大量信息，后期重新拉伸时容易断层。语域：科普教学，比喻深化+原因解释。
sentences: 你可以把色深理解成色彩的阶梯，阶梯越多，色彩过渡就越自然。
Think of color depth as a staircase — more steps mean smoother color transitions.
a staircase（阶梯）；smooth transitions（平滑过渡）
当你的相机支持10bit时，就可以拍出颜色过渡更加自然的画面。
When your camera supports 10-bit, you can capture footage with much smoother color transitions.
capture footage（拍摄画面）
由于颜色细分不够，就会很容易看到画面断层。
Because the color gradations aren't fine enough, banding becomes easy to spot.
banding becomes easy to spot（容易看到断层）
paraphrase: 色彩过渡 → color transitions / smooth gradients
color transitions · gradients
容易看到断层 → banding becomes easy to spot / banding shows up
easy to spot · banding shows up
scenes.speak: Think of color depth as a staircase — more steps mean smoother color transitions. When your camera supports 10-bit, you can capture footage with much smoother color transitions. Because the color gradations aren't fine enough, banding becomes easy to spot.

scenes.title_en: 4:2:0 / 4:2:2: The Secret of the Human Eye
scenes.context: 人眼有一个特点：对画面亮度明暗极其敏感，但对色彩细微变化没那么挑剔。每个像素都有明度值和色度值，工程师发现每个像素必须保留明度信息，但不一定要保留色度信息，可以由多个像素共享一个色度值，大幅减少视频存储数据量，同时画面看上去依旧正常。语域：科普教学，原理讲解。
sentences: 人眼对画面的亮度明暗极其敏感，但对色彩的细微变化却没那么挑剔。
The human eye is extremely sensitive to brightness but much less picky about subtle color shifts.
sensitive to brightness（对亮度敏感）；subtle color shifts（色彩细微变化）
每个像素都具有明度值和色度值。
Every pixel has both a luma value and a chroma value.
luma（明度）；chroma（色度）
多个像素共享一个色度值，可以大大减少视频存储的数据量。
Having multiple pixels share one chroma value slashes the amount of video data stored.
share one chroma value（共享色度值）；slash the data（大幅减少数据量）
paraphrase: 明度/色度 → luma and chroma / brightness and color info
luma · chroma
大幅减少 → slash the data / cut the file size dramatically
slash the data · cut the size
scenes.speak: The human eye is extremely sensitive to brightness but much less picky about subtle color shifts. Every pixel has both a luma value and a chroma value. Having multiple pixels share one chroma value slashes the amount of video data stored.

scenes.context: 用格子图解释：每行四个格子是第一个数字4。420指第一行记录两个格子的色度信息、第二行记录零个（继承第一行）；422指两行各记录两个色度信息；444指两行四格全记录，是专业电影机才有的规格。这些数字被称之为色度采样。语域：科普教学，图解演示。
sentences: 每行四个格子，就是第一个数字4。
Four squares per row is what the first digit, 4, stands for.
stands for（代表）
第一行记录两个格子的色度信息，这是第二个数字2。
The first row records chroma for two squares — that's the second digit, 2.
records chroma（记录色度信息）
4:4:4 色彩全记录，这是专业电影机才会有的规格。
4:4:4 keeps all the color — a spec you only find on professional cinema cameras.
cinema cameras（电影机）
paraphrase: 代表 → stands for / refers to
stands for · refers to
色彩全记录 → keeps all the color / captures full color
keeps all the color · full color
scenes.speak: Four squares per row is what the first digit, 4, stands for. The first row records chroma for two squares — that's the second digit, 2. 4:4:4 keeps all the color — a spec you only find on professional cinema cameras.

scenes.title_cn: 总结：什么时候需要更高规格
scenes.title_en: Summary: When You Need the Higher Spec
scenes.context: 日常拍摄即便用4:2:0依旧能获得不错的画面。但当你要进行更精细的二级调色和抠像时，由于许多像素没有自己的色度值，就会出现颜色溢出、边缘发糊等问题。语域：科普教学，总结建议。
sentences: 即便使用4:2:0色度采样，依旧能获得一个看上去不错的画面。
Even with 4:2:0 chroma subsampling, you can still get a perfectly good-looking image.
chroma subsampling（色度采样）
当你要进行更加精细的二级调色和抠像时。
When you need more precise secondary color grading and keying.
secondary grading（二级调色）；keying（抠像）
由于许多像素没有自己的色度值，就会出现颜色溢出、边缘发糊等问题。
Because many pixels lack their own chroma value, you'll run into color bleed and soft edges.
color bleed（颜色溢出）；soft edges（边缘发糊）
paraphrase: 色度采样 → chroma subsampling / color sampling
chroma subsampling · color sampling
颜色溢出 → color bleed / fringing
color bleed · fringing
scenes.speak: Even with 4:2:0 chroma subsampling, you can still get a perfectly good-looking image. When you need more precise secondary color grading and keying. Because many pixels lack their own chroma value, you'll run into color bleed and soft edges.

practice: That obvious boundary between colors is called color banding.
8-bit gives about 16.7 million colors; 10-bit gives about 1.07 billion.
The human eye is sensitive to brightness but picky about color shifts.
For secondary grading and keying, 4:2:0 causes color bleed and soft edges.
pitfalls: The line between colors is called color breaking.
The boundary between colors is called color banding.
「色彩断层」是 color banding，不是 color breaking。
英文用 million 表达万级数字：16.7 million（1670万）。
The human eye is not careful to colors.
The human eye is much less picky about subtle color shifts.
「没那么挑剔」用 be picky about（挑剔），不是 careful。
4:4:4 records all colors, used by film machine.
4:4:4 keeps all the color — a spec found on professional cinema cameras.
电影机是 cinema camera，不是 film machine。
shifts: 说颜色多只会 many colors
用 16.7 million（1670万）、1.07 billion（10.7亿）、64x difference（64倍差距）量化
说画面不自然只会 not smooth
用 color banding（色彩断层）、banding artifacts（断层伪影）、gradients（渐变）
用 chroma subsampling（色度采样）、share one chroma value（共享色度值）、luma/chroma（明度色度）
